race.description: Thankyou Members & Sponsors Of 2025/26 Mdn Plate
race.comment: DIAMOND EYE (11) looks ready for a peak performance third-up after a couple of nice performances this time in. Gets to 1400m for the first time in her career and draws better than a number of key rivals. ROSE OF CHURCHILL (13) has not raced since her debut back on December 18 when she finished seventh over 1422m at Seymour. Will have a lot more to offer this time judging by some handy jumpouts in preparation for this. TALKIN' STERN (9) is resuming from a lay-off. Ran sixth in a jump-out at Cranbourne. Opened last campaign with a fourth at Pakenham over 1200m. In the mix. GOOD LORDY ME (5) returns from a break. Ran fifth in a jump-out at Cranbourne. Opened last campaign with a fourth at Warrnambool over 1200m. Consistent last prep and can feature.
